macApprove.title: Approve from the Mac's notifications
macApprove.note: While you are at the Mac (a key or the mouse touched lately) and the menu bar icon is running, a request from Claude is held for up to 20 seconds so you can press Allow / Deny on its notification. A risky command only gets Deny. Turn it off and Claude asks in the IDE straight away, as before; so it does when you are away.

loop.title: Stuck loops
loop.note: When a session runs the same thing and gets the same error again and again, its next try is blocked and Claude is told to change course; a card in the chat lets you stop it or send a hint. It also points out compaction after compaction, and spending with no file edited.
loop.costAfter: Spending with no file edited for
loop.install: Run `node bin/cli.mjs install` once more so Claude Code checks with the office before each step.

farewell.title: Farewells
farewell.on: Say goodbye to projects gone quiet
farewell.note: A project that really was at work (two days or more) and has had no session for a long while gets a last afternoon: its person packs the desk into a box, everyone signs a card, a small cake, a group photo, the badge handed back to HR. It is only a scene in the office: nothing about the project is touched. Open the project again and its person comes back to the old company.
